title: Positioning
text: AMReye.AI should be positioned as an AMR/AST-first modular microbiology platform that can expand into research and laboratory automation. It should not be positioned as the only AI plate-imaging system: established products already validate smart incubation, digital imaging, AI plate analysis, automated ID/AST and full laboratory automation [S16-S19].
tables: Make plate-based work more observable, standardized, traceable and automatable.
AI-assisted disk-diffusion measurement, direct MIC workflow, standards rules, QC and human verification.
RGB/NIR/fluorescence phenomics, 3D profilometry, VOC fingerprinting, kinetic imaging and controlled atmospheres.
Robotic plate handling, constrained liquid handling and BAHU-driven orchestration.
Edge-first operation with optional cloud synchronization, multi-site governance and APIs.
Build the first validated workflow deeply; keep optional modules modular and claim-limited.
